Our Mission
We aim to help each student achieve their best A-level results in a nurturing, supportive environment. Building self-confidence and well-being is central to our mission, leading to successful university applications and success in the wider employment world.

About Us | LSI Independent College
LSI Independent College provides high-quality, fully accredited programmes including A Level, Pre A Level, and Foundation Programme. We prepare students from all over the world to gain entry into some of the UK’s most prestigious universities.
Outstanding Behaviour Rating 2024
Empowering Our Students to Achieve Their Best
We help students achieve top results in a nurturing, supportive environment, boosting their confidence and well-being for successful university applications and careers.
Small, Tailored Approach to Learning
From enrolment to university admission, we support our students' personal development with advice, small classes, committed teachers, progress testing, and individual study plans, including one-to-one tutorials and supervised self-study.
Small class sizes of 5 on average
Premium Location
Superb location in Hampstead, North London A fully equipped, modern educational facility occupying a spacious Victorian building - just 12 minutes by tube from central London. See more here.
Our Leadership
Welcome from Our Principal Dr. Iman Hami
Welcome to LSI Independent College. We aim to provide academic excellence for our students in a friendly, purposeful and supportive environment; although our approach is socially informal, hard work and the academic success that comes from this, is central to our ethos. We offer a unique personal approach, precisely tailored to students’ needs. Underpinning our commitment to academic success for our students is a dedication to pastoral care. We see the two as going hand in hand in shaping students and their futures. LSI is committed to creating independent students who will take responsibility for their own learning, equipping them not only with the tools that they need for sixth form success, but also with the skills and qualities they need for university and their future careers. LSI has garnered a reputation for excellence over a broad range of areas, from international language centres to preparatory schools and now our sixth form college. During that time LSI has consistently delivered excellent educational courses with years of expertise in advising students about their university choices. This wealth of experience greatly benefits our A level students. The wide range of quality A levels on offer at LSI Independent College, coupled with the supportive environment and excellent pastoral care, will ensure our new students will be successful in this crucial stage of their academic and personal development. I look forward to welcoming you to our college and to the adventure which awaits you. — Dr. Iman Hami
Dr. Iman Hami, who has a PhD in English Literature and over 20 years of experience, is a well-known leader in education. He believes in lifelong learning and has published many works. He helps high-achieving students get into top UK universities like Cambridge. Dr. Hami also has strong connections with UK medical schools and introduced Multiple Mini Interviews at St. George's University London, greatly influencing both academic and medical education.
LSI College Missione Statement
At LSI College, our mission is to provide a small, personalised learning environment where every student is known and valued, ensuring an intimate, community-focused experience. We are strong academically, offering rigorous, globally-relevant programmes that empower students with the knowledge and skills to excel in their careers and personal growth. Our supportive culture fosters collaboration, mentorship, and a network of resources designed to help students thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. At LSI College, we are committed to guiding every student on a path to success through close connections, academic excellence, and unwavering support.

Academic and Extra-curricular Programme
Typical Weekly Schedule
The final look of your timetable will depend on your choice of subjects, typical college day is between 9am and 5pm, with lessons normally finishing at 4pm.
In the first year of A levels, each subject is allocated five hours per week. In the second year of A levels this changes to six hours per week.Most students take three A level subjects.
Although each student's schedule may vary, here is a timetable for a typical A level student.
Exams
In most cases students will be taking their final exams at the end of the second year. Students on one-year programmes will sit all of their papers at the end of that year.
Private Study
Your timetable is likely to contain some free periods, in which you’ll be able to complete homework assignments, prepare for presentations and tests, or socialise with your friends. There are two common spaces on campus to spend your free periods: the student lounge/cafeteria and the student library. The garden is also available during the summer months.
Extra-curricular
There are regular social activities, a welcome and end-of-year party, subject related trips and clubs.
Lower Sixth Enrichment Programme
The enrichment programme is intended to broaden your horizons and inspire you to gain further knowledge in a broad range of areas. It comprises of a series of seminars, workshops and lectures which go beyond your college curriculum. The EPQ can also form part of the enrichment programme.

pageCache.pageTitle: A Season of Success: UFP Students Secure Outstanding University Offers | LSI Independent College
pageCache.text:
A Season of Success: UFP Students Secure Outstanding University Offers
As we approach the exam and study season, I am in regular contact with some students and arrange weekly meetings to help them manage their time and stress effectively. I am also in touch with parents, as their insights are extremely valuable. I strongly believe that student success is a team effort — the college, students, and parents must work together to achieve the best outcomes. Dr Iman Hami Term Highlights Our students have achieved excellent outcomes in this year’s UCAS cycle, securing offers from 24 leading universities across the UK. Notably, 63% of these offers have come from Russell Group institutions, reflecting the strength of their applications and academic preparation. These results highlight both the ambition of our students and the effectiveness of the support they receive throughout the university application process, enabling them to progress confidently to highly competitive institutions. Additionally, our University Foundation Programme students have secured offers from 87% of their university applications. As international students, their hard work and perseverance have paid off, and we wish them all the best. The Year 12 Human Sciences group project was a very successful and enjoyable experience. Each student presented a section of the project linked both to the main topic and to the subject they are planning to study at university in the future. This made the presentations more meaningful and academically focused. The students worked very well as a team, supporting each other and organising the project responsibly. The quality of the presentations was highly academic, and the students demonstrated strong research, communication, and critical thinking skills. We are very proud of their work, and it is clear that a bright future lies ahead for this group. Our students recently took part in a Model United Nations conference hosted by Guildhouse School, where they delivered an outstanding performance and were awarded first place. Throughout the event, they engaged in thoughtful debate, demonstrated strong public speaking skills, and approached complex global issues with confidence and insight. Their ability to collaborate, negotiate, and present well-reasoned arguments reflected both their preparation and their commitment to academic excellence. Experiences such as MUN play an important role in developing key skills including leadership, critical thinking, and effective communication, and we are incredibly proud of how our students represented LSI College. In addition, some students received presents from the Principal in recognition of their achievements, including 100% attendance and achieving the highest number of Green Points (thumbs up) for going above and beyond in their studies and extracurricular activities. These awards recognise not only academic effort but also commitment, responsibility, and positive contribution to college life. We are very proud of these students and hope their achievements will encourage others to aim high and make the most of their time at the college. Upcoming Events in the Summer Term Club Meetings:

Our intensive one-year re-sit programme provides students with the opportunity to improve their current A level grades and reach their full potential. Restart A levels
In consultation with our expert advisers, students may decide to change their subjects and move in a different direction. At LSI we are able to offer great support and flexibility based on individual circumstances.

Students may transfer into the second year of our A level programmes and continue their studies with us. Let Us Guide Your Through a Complex Oxbridge Application Process
We provide tailored support and preparation for students aspiring to apply to Oxford and Cambridge Universities, ensuring they are well-prepared for the rigorous application process and succeed in gaining admission.
The Oxbridge Preparation Program at LSI Independent College identifies high-achieving students early in Year 12 and supports them through tailored academic enrichment, mentoring, and admissions preparation. Through masterclasses, personal statement workshops, mock interviews, and application guidance, students are fully prepared for a competitive Oxbridge application.

Oxbridge Preparation at LSI Independent College
We offer guidance through every aspect of the application process, starting with which course and college to aim for, through to understanding the systems in place, culminating in the interview itself. Our Oxbridge Preparation includes:
Intensive academic preparation – Our small class sizes ensure that every student is given the support and guidance they need to realise their objectives. Students on the Oxbridge Preparation programme will be given a personalised study plan, which is integrated into the general programme.
Personalised study plans – Students receive one-to-one tuition with the Director of Studies and are set an individual study plan that extends beyond the regular scope of the A-level curriculum. Not only does this additional study encourage students to get the best possible A-level results, but it also allows them to explore the subject in greater depth.
Interview practice – Students are given rigorous interview training, either individually or in small groups, to replicate the Oxbridge interview process and make students comfortable in this environment.

Results & University Preparation Services
Results
With classroom sizes of no more than five students, we provide a highly personalised learning experience. Our students consistently achieve outstanding results, with 48% earning A*-A grades, 68% achieving A*-B grades, and 88% getting A*-C grades in their A-Levels. In 2024, 57% of our students were admitted to Russell Group Universities.
Destinations
52% of our students at LSI Independent College gain admission to Russell Group universities and 16% go on to G5 universities. Queen Mary University and University College London rank as the top destinations.
51% of our students study Humanities and 49% study Science. The most sought-after courses include Business and Engineering.

At LSI Independent College, we are committed to ensuring each and every student reaches their potential. Our two-year and intensive A level courses in London are taught in small class sizes at our beautiful campus in Hampstead.
Two Year A Levels In their first year at LSI Independent College, A Level students select three subjects, each with five hours of instruction per week, to prepare for further education and careers. In the second year, they follow the same timetable and add weekly career lessons to better understand their future plans and options. Intensive A Levels The Intensive A Level programme at LSI Independent College is designed for students who have completed Year 2 but wish to improve their grades by repeating their studies. This programme allows students to retake 1 to 3 subjects, with a focus on intensive learning and support.

We curate a diverse range of activities that transcend traditional learning boundaries and go beyond the classroom. This program empowers students to explore the rich tapestry of Central London, and cultivates a lifelong love for learning.
Flexibility is at the heart of our program, with activities subject to change to align seamlessly with evolving student needs and preferences. This ensures that our activity offerings remain responsive and resonate with the diverse passions and aspirations of our students.

Holistic Growth
We believe in nurturing well-rounded individuals beyond academic pursuits. Our Holistic Growth Program is designed to cultivate students into impactful global citizens, equipped with the skills and insights necessary for navigating life’s significant decisions. We cover key areas such as Personal, Social, and Health Education (PSHE), fostering skills beyond traditional subjects. We emphasize cultivating a sense of global citizenship, encouraging students to stay informed about the world and develop the ability to critically analyze information. Additionally, the program underscores the importance of respecting diversity, instilling values that reject prejudice and discrimination. Furthermore, it prepares students for independence and responsibility as they transition into adulthood, focusing on risk assessment and decision-making skills.
Guardianship
All international students must have a designated Education Guardian while in the UK. This provision ensures that there is a contact person available to act on behalf of the student in case of emergencies.

2025-26 Academic Year Highlights of LSI College
Reflecting on the Academic Year at LSI College
As the academic year comes to a close, we are proud to reflect on another successful and enriching year at LSI College. From academic achievements and university progression to enrichment opportunities and student successes, this year has been filled with moments that highlight the dedication, resilience, and ambition of our students and staff.
Below, we look back on some of the key highlights from across the college community.
School Trips & Educational Visits
This year, students took part in a range of educational and cultural trips designed to extend learning beyond the classroom.
These experiences provided students with valuable opportunities to explore new environments, engage with their subjects in real-world contexts, and strengthen connections with their peers.

UCAS & University Progression Update
Supporting students with their future progression remains central to life at LSI College.
We have received offers from 27 leading universities, with 63% of offers coming from Russell Group universities. Our students have also secured interviews with the University of Oxford and King's College London.
We are incredibly proud of our students’ ambitions and the hard work they have shown throughout the application process.
